faqs.q: How does pricing work for custom tees?
faqs.a: Base custom tees start at $25. Final pricing is calculated based on design complexity, shirt color/wash treatment, number of print placements, and size requirements.
Because every shirt is hand-dyed and hand-painted to order, please allow 7-14 business days for production before shipping.

faqs.q: Can I provide my own artwork or garment?
faqs.a: Yes! You can upload your reference artwork in the Custom Order builder. For customer-provided garments, contact us directly for approval.
